title: Polygon2D disappears after Syncing Bones to Polygon (Skeleton2D)
body: ### Tested versions Godot 4.5 Stable ### System information Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 22621) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) HD Graphics Family (0x00000A16) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-20.19.15.5171) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4310U CPU @ 2.00GHz (4 threads) - 7.90 GiB memory ### Issue description I am trying to rig a Skeleton2D and the Polygon2D textures keep disappearing. After some trial and error, I found it seems to be during the Sync Bones to Polygon step. When I choose a Bone2D to sync to, the moment I click elsewhere/focus some other element, the UV texture disappears from the editor. However, it is still visible in the Polygon editor window. Attempting to redraw the UV doesn't work; from this point forward I cannot get any texture to show from the node, even if I completely remove the Texture2D and re-add it. Creating a new node works, but the same error occurs during the same step. **Selecting the bone** **Texture disappears when clicked out of** ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create UVs for Polygon2Ds 2. Create/Rig Skeleton2D 3. Select Bone2D to sync to Polygon2D. 4. Click focus elsewhere (sometimes it takes a couple clicks). 5. Texture disappears from editor. This is reproducible in my project, but I am not sure if this will reproduce it universally. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Since all of the textures of my project disappeared, I only recreated one of them here. Use the `foreleg_left_thigh` node for testing. [minimal-test-skeleton.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22789393/minimal-test-skeleton.zip)
